attempts.artifact:
Feature: Patient Management

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given a new patient with name "John Doe" and date of birth "1990-01-01"
    When the patient is registered
    Then the patient is saved in the database

  Scenario: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given a patient with name "Jane Doe" and date of birth "1995-06-01" already registered
    When the patient's details are viewed and updated
    Then the latest details are saved in the database

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details
    Given a patient with name "Bob Smith" and date of birth "1980-03-01" already registered
    When the patient's details are deleted
    Then the patient's details are not deleted if there is one or more Consultation Requests in last 3 years

  Scenario: Rollback by a month
    Given a patient with name "Alice Johnson" and date of birth "1992-09-01" already registered
    When the system is rolled back by a month
    Then the patient's details are restored to the previous state

  Scenario: Restore back-up
    Given a patient with name "Mike Brown" and date of birth "1975-12-01" already registered
    When the back-up is restored
    Then the patient's details are restored from the back-up

  Scenario: Purge dummy production database
    Given a patient with name "Emma Taylor" and date of birth "1985-06-01" already registered
    When the dummy production database is purged
    Then the patient's details are deleted from the dummy production database

  Scenario: Store back-up in fire proof cabinet
    Given a patient with name "David Lee" and date of birth "1998-03-01" already registered
    When the back-up is stored in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    Then the back-up is stored in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital

weaknesses: Mislabeling of requirement in TC-001 (references VIRTUA-5-17 instead of Req-5/1).
No negative test for Register a new Patient (e.g., duplicate patient).
No boundary tests for "last 3 years" (exact 3-year boundary).
No boundary tests for "rollback by a month" (e.g., 1 day before/after).
Concrete values (patient names, dates) are arbitrary and not grounded; tests should use realistic or parameterized data.
